alt: A glowing dotted globe turns inside a glass orbital ring on a deep navy field, circled by floating translucent cards for art, music, film and food, beside the line 'Explore what you love. Discover where it lives.'
A brass clockwork dial glows amber as its ring of decades turns, beside the heading 'Step into any decade.' and illustrated cards of Miami sunsets, palms and sound bars labelled by decade.
On pale paper, a thin blue line links round icons for a featured artist, the WAVEMAKERS programme, Miami, the Art Deco movement and an untitled film, under the heading 'Every story has a reason.'

A neon purple and pink catalogue: a player window labelled 'Preview feature · Miami Nights' shows a synthwave sunset behind a city skyline, surrounded by rows of tiles for music, film, sport, food and art marked Free or Premium, with search filters for Miami, Music and Free.

A circular vault door with an iris-like core glows teal at the centre of a dark interface, flanked by panels for saved items, journeys and continue watching; the access label below changes between Free and Premium.

Pastel line-art cities inside an arched frame: London with a clock tower, terraced houses and a red bus, and Miami with an Art Deco hotel, palm trees and waves, each with its coordinates, 'What's here' cards for music, film and fashion, and a world-map strip below.

Bold Bauhaus-style geometry on bright yellow: the words 'ART' and 'FILM' in heavy black type beside a painter's palette and brush, a film reel and a red play triangle, with three abstract poster cards.

A navy 'Culture Passport' with a gold compass emblem opens to a hand-drawn map with a dotted trail between Miami and San Juan, and a page of circular travel stamps, Miami and San Juan stamped and two slots still empty.
The words 'MONUMENTAL STREAMS' in polished chrome serif letters catch passing glints of light on black, mirrored below, with the line 'Explore what you love. Discover where it lives.'
A biomechanical tunnel of ribbed, pearl-grey rings spirals toward a soft glowing centre, with a segmented spine running along its lilac floor.

Ribbons of aurora light drift behind a sound panel titled 'Sound: designed tones for every action', with a sound-on switch, a master level slider, output meters and six waveform tiles labelled Activate, Select, Save, Transition, Time tick and Error.

A dark grid of six panels demonstrates cursor states (Explore, Play, Drag, Save, Open and Orbit), each a different small shape, above the line 'Cursor adapts to context. Native cursor remains as fallback.'

Three phone screens of the Monumental Streams app on a terracotta background (a home feed, a browse view and a player) beside the heading 'Built for touch.' and the line 'Swipe, save, and resume where you left off.'

A pastel search screen with 'miami' typed in the search bar and filter chips for place, interest, access and duration; the results move between a grid of colourful geometric tiles and an empty state reading 'Nothing here yet. Try removing a filter.'

An isometric illustration of a Miami-area waterfront, with beach, palms, low-rise Deco buildings, glass towers, boats and a low sun, and map pins for South Beach, Wynwood, Little Havana and Brickell, under the heading 'Miami, up close.' and the note 'Illustrative map, not to scale'.

Cut-paper letters spell 'THE STORY BEHIND THE STORY' above four pinned paper cards with simple symbols: The Decision (a forked path), The Relationship (two overlapping circles), The Setback (a broken step) and The Turning Point (a bending arrow).
Flowing blue lines of light ripple like water across black beneath the title 'VALID ID PRESENTS WAVEMAKERS', with 'Puerto Rico, New York to London' along the bottom and an 'In development' tag.

A cream retro console labelled 'Take Me Somewhere', with a small screen listing a short itinerary, mood buttons for Chill, Lively, Culture and Late, dials for interest, time and destination, and a large red GO button.
Placeholder artwork: a biomechanical tunnel of ribbed, pearl-grey rings spiralling toward a soft glowing centre.
